title: When Exact Inference Changes Code Selection: A Decision-Theoretic Analysis of B4
abstract: arXiv:2611.23306v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When generated programs are ranked using generated tests, a more exact posterior computation need not improve the selected program. We characterize this distinction in the published B4 code--test model. Identical execution signatures reduce exact candidate marginalization to N summands and nonempty joint maximum a posteriori (MAP) inference to two weights per group. A prior--budget condition guarantees that B4's whole-group rule already attains MAP; a sharp finite correction bound certifies when candidate marginals must select the same group. All 2,421 default-setting comparisons on 807 development matrices select the same candidates. A prospectively specified validation on 1,345 execution snapshots from a separate public archive also finds no changes in 4,035 default-setting comparisons. Across 80 literature-derived priors, this new archive yields 85 changed top sets in 107,600 comparisons; only six coincide with failure of whole-group

translated_title: 何时精确推断会改变代码选择：对B4的决策论分析
translated_abstract: 当使用生成的测试对生成的程序进行排序时，更精确的后验计算未必能改进所选的程序。我们在已发表的B4代码-测试模型中对这一区别进行了刻画。相同的执行签名将精确的候选边缘化简化为N个求和项，并将非空的联合最大后验（MAP）推断简化为每组两个权重。一个先验-预算条件保证了B4的整组规则已经达到MAP；一个尖锐的有限修正界证明了候选边缘何时必须选择相同的组。在807个开发矩阵上的全部2,421次默认设置比较中，所选候选完全相同。对一个来自独立公共档案的1,345个执行快照进行的前瞻性规范验证，同样在4,035次默认设置比较中未发现任何变化。在80个源自文献的先验下，这一新档案在107,600次比较中产生了85个变化的顶级集合；其中仅有六个与整组规则的失效相吻合。
tldr: 本文通过决策论分析精确刻画了在B4代码-测试模型中更精确的后验推断何时会改变程序选择——给出了保证整组规则已达MAP的先验-预算条件与有限修正界，并在大量实证比较中表明精确推断几乎从不改变所选代码。
en_tdlr: This decision-theoretic analysis of the B4 code-test model establishes a prior-budget condition and a sharp finite correction bound that exactly characterize when more precise posterior inference can change program selection, empirically showing that exact MAP inference almost never alters the selected code.
